lead: Mike Tyson is an American boxer, born on 30 June 1966 in Brooklyn.
As of 2026, he is 60 years old, and his birth date places him under the Cancer sign.
He has 38 credited works on public record and has been recognised with WWE Hall of Fame and International Boxing Hall of Fame.
This profile collects the Mike facts readers search for most — date of birth and current age, height and physical stats, family and relationship details, education, and a dated career timeline.

paras: Net-worth figures for Mike Tyson circulate widely online, but almost none of them come from an audited or officially published source. BioStar does not invent or repeat unsourced numbers, so no dollar figure is stated on this page.
